gaps.title: External authority evidence is cryptographically non-self-issuable
gaps.close_criteria: A repository writer cannot manufacture accepted closure: every submission and decision is verified under a current, non-revoked, narrowly scoped Ed25519 key from an externally pinned trust registry; the pinned PEM is re-encoded and required to contain the id-Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo algorithm and a 32-byte public key; candidate, claims, artifact digests, limitations, evidence-set digest and reviewed gaps are signed; key-type confusion, issuer/reviewer aliases and synthetic physical evidence fail closed.
